Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Datacentre bargain trips now use fixed one-shot travel steps with explicit waits: 5 seconds after world arrival, one Sapphire Avenue Exchange warp request, 5 seconds after Sapphire, one Market Board run request, 3 seconds after the Market Board opens, 2 seconds after closing Market Board windows, and 3 seconds after the Ul'dah Aetheryte Plaza warp request. Repeated Sapphire and Market Board movement requests have been removed to prevent rapid command loops under lag.
